summary: FindLocationForWorksheet is a web form used to search, filter, select, and create worksheet entries for locations within a system, leveraging multiple lookup fields and workflow actions. It enables users to find destinations for a worksheet using agency, governing organization, site type, service, region, province, discipline, keyword, and more. Selected locations can be grouped and worksheet entries created, subject to validation rules and dynamic behaviors.
purpose: To allow authorized users to locate, filter, select, and create worksheet entries for destinations based on a variety of criteria, and to manage related reporting and workflow actions for worksheet assignment.

fields.name: txtGroupSize
fields.purpose: Number of worksheet entries to create

workflows.name: Search for Locations
steps: User loads page; query parameters WorksheetID and CFOFlag provided.
Lookup data loaded for dropdown filters.
User enters search keyword and selects filters.
Locations are retrieved and displayed in gridData.

workflows.name: Select and Create Worksheet Entries
steps: User checks desired rows in gridData (each with Site, Service, Destination ID).
User enters Group Size and selects 'Use Template' if required.
Worksheet entries are created for selected destinations.
ASSD cache is cleared to update worksheet screen.

workflows.name: Clear Filters
steps: Fields are reset; gridData is cleared.

business_rules: Create function is disabled unless WorksheetID and CFOFlag are supplied.
Group Size defaults to 1 for individual worksheet scenario (IWSFlag).
All dropdowns default to 'ALL' selection when initialized.
Worksheet entries created only for selected rows.
ASSD cache must be cleared after worksheet entry creation.
validations: Keyword search must be provided for certain validation groups.
Group Size must be a valid integer and required if creating entries.
Multiple validation summaries manage error/display for both search and create actions.
Custom client and server validations are used for search fields.
calculations: Matches count updates as results are bound to gridData.
Group Size value affects number of worksheet entries created.
conditions: If Group Size is missing or invalid, defaults to 1.
If filters are not selected, dropdowns default to 'ALL'.
If WorksheetID or CFOFlag are missing, create button is hidden.
system_behavior: Page uses hash validation on load for security.
Grid supports paging; too many results triggers a warning message.
JavaScript registers client-side field variables and manages select all/none functions.
User interface dynamically shows/hides elements based on post back or clear action.
exceptions: Too many search results triggers a warning and help link.
Errors and warnings shown in pnlError and pnlWarning panels.
Validation errors trigger summaries or client messages.
content_gaps: Underlying business logic for Location.CreateWorksheetEntries and reporting utilities is not shown.
Exact structure and options for dropdowns (e.g., agency, site type, service lists) depend on external data.
User authorization process and security checks are referenced but not fully detailed.
Some error handling and validation rules may depend on external resource files or client-side scripts.
